title: Elf-Goblin United Front
description:
Event-collecting RPG

30 Basic CGs

2 ENDs

---

STORY

---

It was the final stage of the "Great War against the Demons".

After the various races of the continent united to fight the demons,

the demons were gradually facing defeat, and peace seemed within reach.

However...

One forest, where elves and goblins lived,

remained under the constant threat of demon invasion.

Amidst this situation, the elves and goblins, long-standing enemies...

They made a crucial decision.

It was the formation of the "Elf-Goblin United Front".

---

GAMEPLAY

---

Each turn, you can select "Train", "Attack", "Rest" or "Explore".

The success rate and effect are influenced by various factors.
